Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: 2 different dorms

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: You could pay for catered rooms or cook in the apartment kitchen or in the common area kitchen

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: People living in student accommodation on campus is usually quite young (19 yo) and its often the first time they live away from their parents

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The website was so confusing. The available info for exchange student was not sufficient imo

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I had to enroll in some different subjects (4 in total) but they would not approve me for the once i had chosen, because i didn't have the required courses previously. The problem was, that there was so few subjects to choose from, so i had to convince them to let me take the ones, they did not approve in the first place. They did and I had no trouble with understanding the subject.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I emailed, and they did answer rather quickly

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: In the end, I got what I wanted, but I had to convince the host uni - which seems unnessesary

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Dont panick if they do not approve your choices the first time around. Just contact them and explain the situation. I found that they were quite willing to help out

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: 8th semester

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Very different - they have attendance requirements and the exams are very different. They had written assigments and tests during the semester and no final exams

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester
